status: frozen for the NGH-Seis v1.0 public release
purpose: Reproduce the marine streamer acoustic observations and seafloor-relative adjoint-migration view released with NGH-Seis v1.0.

formal_production_acquisition.admission_evidence: sample 0001 25-vs-49 image correlation 0.9989088 with no material worsening of directional-artifact gates

field_aligned_release_view.coordinate_rule: seafloor-relative sampling with anti-alias filtering before lateral decimation
field_aligned_release_view.physical_pixel_note: the 3 m vertical and 37.5 m horizontal spacings are intentionally anisotropic; array shape does not imply square physical pixels

amplitude_protocol.synthetic: one robust scale fitted only on the frozen synthetic training split
amplitude_protocol.field: separate label-free scalar/spectral calibration fitted only on designated EW0008 calibration crosslines
amplitude_protocol.claim: zero-label field calibration, not uncalibrated zero-shot

admitted_quality_evidence: seafloor-relative resampling with lateral anti-alias filtering
1000 accepted samples passed finite-value, shape, saturation and RTM image gates
declared_limitations: absorbing top boundary without a pressure-release free surface
no intrinsic attenuation or added acquisition noise
regional ODP-constrained stochastic priors rather than through-well Site 997 inversion
output is an acoustic adjoint-state migration or RTM-style velocity gradient, not industrial amplitude-preserving PSDM

recording.surface_boundary: absorbing PML; no pressure-release free surface

marine_acquisition_reference.role: 49-shot reference geometry used by the shot-density gate and as the parent grid for the frozen 25-shot subset
marine_acquisition_reference.streamer_direction: receivers trail to smaller x than the source
marine_acquisition_reference.grid_exactness: all coordinates are exact integer multiples of the 5 m propagation grid
